canonical.nativeSql: SELECT e.region_code, AVG(c.monthly_salary) AS average_salary, AVG(CASE WHEN e.resigned THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS attrition_rate FROM hr.employees e JOIN hr.compensation_history c ON e.employee_id = c.employee_id WHERE c.effective_date = DATE '2024-09-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
